company.name: Cignara
company.shortDescription: Cignara is an agentic AI company that provides AI voice, chat, and copilot agents for enterprise customer support and sales operations.
company.description: Cignara develops conversational AI software for large B2C enterprises, focusing on customer support and sales workflows. The company provides AI agents that handle inbound requests over phone, chat, and other digital channels, resolving common issues end to end within existing systems of record. Its platform constructs an enterprise knowledge graph from product data, policies, and transactional records to guide controlled, auditable interactions. Cignara also offers an AI copilot that assists human contact center staff with real-time answers, policy lookups, and workflow completion across multiple languages. The products are designed for industries with high-volume customer interactions, such as retail, banking, telecom, travel, and healthcare. Cignara integrates with existing IT stacks to support policy-driven guardrails, security, and analytics on intents, resolutions, and customer sentiment.
